items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt zwei Wochen; sie beginnt mit der Zustellung dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The notice was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO) and the attached envelope copy is marked 'zugestellt' 28.10.2026 (Wednesday) — this actual service date governs, not the 4-day deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself (28.10.) is not counted; the two-week period starts 29.10.2026 and, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day of the second following week bearing the same name as the day of the event, i.e. Wednesday 11.11.2026. That day is a normal working day in Niedersachsen (no holiday), so it stands as the deadline — the objection must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs once the Bescheid becomes final
items.quote: Zahlen müssen Sie erst, wenn der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist; fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen danach.
items.computation: Payment is due only if no Einspruch is filed. If so, the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) upon expiry of the Einspruchsfrist, i.e. at the end of Wednesday 11.11.2026. Treating 11.11.2026 as the triggering event (as with the service-date counting above), the day itself is not counted (§187 Abs. 1 BGB) and the two-week payment period starts 12.11.2026, ending on Wednesday 25.11.2026 (§188 Abs. 2 BGB) — again a normal working day, so no further shift applies. This date only applies if the Bescheid is not challenged; filing an Einspruch removes this payment obligation for now.

warnings: The payment due date (25.11.2026) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 11.11.2026; filing an objection suspends the fine's finality and this payment deadline.

Both computed dates rely on the handwritten 'zugestellt 28.10.2026' note on the enclosed envelope copy (page 2) rather than an independently confirmed delivery record; if the actual postal service date differs, both deadlines shift accordingly.

Before transferring money, verify the recipient name shown by your bank's mandatory payee-name check (Empfängerüberprüfung) against 'Landkreis Musterheide' / 'Kreissparkasse Musterheide' before paying to IBAN DE90 2500 0000 0009 7000 00, even though the IBAN itself is well-formed.
